captain_obvious_readout: DO_NOT_MULTIPLY_FACTOR_LOCAL_PAYLOADS. FIRST TEST THE CHEAPEST EXACT CASE: A UNIQUE SURVIVING COMMON-CORE STATE AND PAIRWISE-DISJOINT RESIDUAL SCOPES. REUSE THE SEALED FACTORIZED-PORTFOLIO PRINCIPLE CONDITIONED ON THAT CORE STATE. ANY RESIDUAL CROSS-COUPLING, MULTIPLE CORE STATES, OR INCOMPLETE TARGET-COMPONENT COVERAGE FAILS CLOSED.
scope: The v3.4 common-core successor returns OPEN_COMMON_CORE_FILTERED_BUCKET_STILL_OVER_L2 on one target cut-separated component. The failed bucket is the first private-variable bucket of that target component. Every relation in the target component is one of the failed-bucket factors, every target relation contains the derived common core C, the exact common support S has size exactly one, and after conditioning on the unique s in S and deleting C from scopes, the residual scopes of target relations are pairwise disjoint.

formal_mechanism.unique_core: Compute C and S exactly from the frozen v1.1 predecessor. Require |S|=1 and denote its unique state by s.
formal_mechanism.complete_target_coverage: Require the failed-bucket factor IDs to equal all original relation IDs of the target cut component. No target relation may be omitted because it does not contain the failed variable.
formal_mechanism.condition: For every target relation R_i, retain exactly rows whose C-projection equals s, then remove C coordinates only inside a derived carrier while preserving the original row as reconstruction provenance.
formal_mechanism.residual_dependency: Let D_i = scope(R_i)\C. Require D_i pairwise disjoint. Any shared residual variable merges factors and returns OPEN_RESIDUAL_CROSS_COUPLING.
formal_mechanism.boundary_projection: For each conditioned R_i, existentially project its factor-local private variables D_i\B and retain only B_i=D_i∩B. Store the exact boundary row set plus one original-row reconstruction witness for each boundary tuple. If B_i is empty, nonempty conditioned rows certify that local factor is existentially satisfiable and it contributes no boundary factor.
formal_mechanism.portfolio: Store the target-component boundary as a list of independent boundary factors, never their Cartesian product. This is the conditioned analogue of the sealed factorized-feedback portfolio.
formal_mechanism.global_handoff: Replace the target component by its derived boundary factors, keep every other original cut-separated component unchanged, and invoke the sealed guarded elimination engine with the original canonical cut. The transformed instance must not be larger than a fixed polynomial in original L and must not contain target private variables in active constraints.
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: Take the transformed exact witness, set C=s, and independently select the stored original row for each target relation matching its boundary assignment. Pairwise-disjoint residual scopes guarantee local payload assignments cannot conflict. Replay the completed assignment against every original relation.
formal_mechanism.exactness: Conditioning on the unique exact common-core state loses no satisfying target assignment because every satisfying assignment must use s. Pairwise-disjoint residual scopes make the conditioned conjunction equal the conjunction of independent residual factors. Boundary projection is exact existential elimination of factor-local payload variables.
formal_mechanism.complexity: Core support scan, residual dependency audit, conditioning, boundary projection, portfolio storage and reconstruction are polynomial in explicit tuple cells. No target-factor Cartesian product is materialized. The transformed guarded handoff inherits the frozen original-L polynomial envelope; transformed explicit size is O(L).

negative_controls.construction: Start from the sticky control and make two target factors share one payload variable outside C while preserving the unique common-core state and predecessor overbudget condition.
Create a still-overbudget target component with at least two exact common-core states surviving semijoin.
Add an exact relation to the same target component that does not contain the failed variable, so it is not in the failed bucket.
